verdict.rationale: Puzzle offers an 'AI Close' feature, auto-categorization (up to 98%), custom rules, batch categorization, and PDF/CSV import via Accounting AI, all pointing toward automated month-end close with human review ('reviewed by you before anything's final'). However, evidence is entirely vendor-claimed marketing/docs with no independent verification of an agent autonomously reconciling, flagging exceptions, and preparing a full close end-to-end.
